submitted.rationale: Of the three compositions measured, 137 (Cu0.50 Fe0.19 V0.30) had the highest photocurrent, 7.2e-7 A. That is 1.7x the Cu:V≈1:1 point and 1.9x the V-rich point. XRD shows a distinct Cu-rich vanadate-type phase (sample peaks at Q≈1.65, 2.13, 2.26, 2.49 and 3.02 Å⁻¹, besides the SnO2 substrate peaks). This fits the reduced-gap copper vanadates that absorb 2.4 eV photons.

rejected.reason: Measured 4.2e-7 A. Cu:V ~1:1 with low Fe; weak phase peaks, lower photocurrent.
Measured 3.8e-7 A. V-rich, XRD dominated by V2O5-like peaks, which is a poor photoanode.
XRD only; no merit budget left to test. Fe-rich Cu-Fe-V oxides are expected to have poor carrier transport.
